outcome: incidence of acute peripartum twin-twin transfusion syndrome
finding: The incidence of acute peripartum twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS) was 2.5% in this cohort, and birth order and mode of delivery were associated with increased risk.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery occurred more often in the acute peripartum TTTS group compared to the control group of uncomplicated MC pregnancies, 100% (6/6) versus 57% (135/235) (P = 0.002), respectively.
